*[[Bear attack]]s
**A [[polar bear]] attacks and kills a woman and her son in [[Wales, Alaska|Wales]], [[Alaska]], [[United States]], after charging several others, in the first fatal attack since the early 1980s. The bear is shot and killed following the attack.  [https://www.cnn.com/2023/01/18/us/alaska-polar-bear-attack/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-64315398 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Aging of China]]
**The [[National Bureau of Statistics of China|National Bureau of Statistics]] reports that [[Demographics of China|China's population]], [[List of countries and dependencies by population|the largest in the world]], [[Population decline|declined]] for the first time since 1960, with a population decrease of 850,000 people reported in the past year. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230117-china-population-shrinks-for-first-time-in-over-60-years (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/16/business/china-birth-rate.html (''The New York Times'')]
